first_missing_criterion: canonical BUILDING_PRESENT parcel AOI plus dataset-specific confirmation of the coordinate reference system and archive-internal DTM tile filenames for the Belfast City 2006 North East Zone. This unused official Spatial NI Data Supply Metadata guidance window identifies Irish Grid (TM65) [EPSG:29902] as the data-supply spatial reference system in the published guidance, but it is a generic Spatial NI supply rule rather than evidence that the Belfast City 2006 LiDAR resource itself uses that CRS; the PDF page screenshot transport also returned Cache miss. Therefore EPSG:29902 is retained only as generic official context and is not assigned to the Belfast LiDAR record, and no tile filename, geometry, CRS binding or parcel binding is fabricated.
